newsitem.title: USA: Republic to buy firm for $40 mln in stock.
newsitem.headline: Republic to buy firm for $40 mln in stock.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said Thursday it had signed a definitive agreement to buy privately held York Waste Disposal Inc for $40 million in Republic stock.
York provides waste collection services in south-central Pennsylvania and northern Maryland, Republic said.
Republic did not say what York's annual revenues were or what the acquisition would mean to its bottom line. Republic officials were not available for comment.
The acquisition's close is subject to regulatory approval and other conditions, Republic said.
